title: Past actions: what happened and what was in progress

sections.title: Past Simple or Past Continuous?
sections.content: Use Past Continuous for an action in progress and Past Simple for a shorter action that happened during it. Türkçe ipucu: devam eden eylem için was/were + -ing kullan.

questions.prompt: I ___ dinner when the phone rang.
While they ___ home, it started to rain.
The lights went out while we ___ a film.
Which sentence describes a finished action?
Choose the best pair: “I ___ my keys while I ___ for the bus.”

sections.title: A small interruption
sections.content: Read: “Mina was walking to the station when she saw an old friend. They talked for five minutes, then Mina caught the next train.” Notice the long action and the short events.

choices: She was walking to the station.

questions.prompt: What did Mina do after the conversation?

sections.title: Tell a short story
sections.content: Say three sentences aloud: 1) what you were doing, 2) what happened, and 3) what you did next. Example: “I was leaving work when I met a colleague. We talked, and then I went home.”
